title: Training Notes: Repeat-Visit Relief on Harbison Labor-Only Protection Service Fees
content:
**What is repeat-visit relief?**
On a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, repeat-visit relief keeps the service fees of a holder whose equipment needs repeated repairs within a year from stacking up. It works through a repeat-visit fee share that applies by multiplication to the claim service fee for the call.

**What is counted?**
The number of other claims on the contract approved or partially approved on their original decision in the twelve calendar months before the date of handling, read from the contract's claim history. The claims of this service call are not counted.

**What share applies?**

| Other approved or partially approved claims in the twelve months | Repeat-visit fee share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.25 |
| exactly one | 0.50 |
| none | 1 |

**Does a denied claim count?**
No. Only claims whose original decision approved or partially approved them are counted.

**Does a claim decided thirteen months ago count?**
No. The window is the twelve calendar months before the date of handling.

**Example (hypothetical).** On the date of handling, the contract shows an approved claim from four months ago, a partially approved claim from nine months ago, a denied claim from six months ago, and two approved claims on today's service call. The two claims on today's call are not counted and the denied claim does not count, leaving two other claims: share 0.25.
